fullDescription: A high-tech, dark-mode logistics marketplace with a focus on 3D depth and glassmorphism. Featuring a carbon fiber texture, animated gradient backgrounds, and responsive grid layouts. Ideal for SaaS dashboards, transport management, fintech, or any industrial service platform. Keywords: dark mode, blue glow, glassmorphism, 3D hover, logistics, editorial typography, Satoshi, Cabinet Grotesk, responsive grid, sidebar filters.

structured.summary: A sophisticated dark-themed logistics search results interface characterized by 3D-transforming listing cards, translucent glassmorphic UI elements, and high-contrast blue and emerald accents. The design utilizes a 'depth-first' approach with perspective containers and staggered scroll animations to create an immersive, premium user experience.

style.description: The style is 'Dark 3D Modern'. It uses a deep midnight background (#050811) with a subtle carbon fiber pattern and a moving 4-color gradient. Typography pairs the bold, geometric 'Cabinet Grotesk' for headers with the clean, legible 'Satoshi' for interface text. UI elements are glassmorphic with thin 1px borders (rgba(255,255,255,0.08)) and 12px background blurs. Buttons and interactive states use vibrant blue (#2563eb) and emerald (#10b981) shadows to signify action.
style.prompt: Create a design with a background color of #050811 and a 400% 400% animated linear gradient (-45deg, #050811, #1e3a8a, #0f172a, #172554). Overlap this with a carbon fiber texture at 20% opacity. Typography: Headings in 'Cabinet Grotesk' (Extrabold, 800/700), Body in 'Satoshi' (400/500/700). Colors: Primary Blue (#2563eb), Success Emerald (#10b981), Warning Amber (#fbbf24), Text White (#f8fafc), Text Muted (#94a3b8). Components must use a 'Glass' style: background rgba(255,255,255,0.03), backdrop-filter blur(12px), and a border of 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08). Interactive elements should feature 3D transforms using cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1) and reveal-on-scroll animations with a 30px Y-translate offset.

layout_and_structure.description: A 12-column responsive layout featuring a fixed glass header, a 288px sidebar for filtering, and a flexible results grid. The layout prioritizes vertical scanning on mobile and a dashboard-like arrangement on desktop.

prompts.prompt: Fixed top navigation. Max-width 7xl. Container: glassmorphic, rounded-2xl, px-6 py-3. Elements: Left-aligned logo with a blue icon box (#2563eb) and 'TruckAda' text; Center-aligned horizontal nav links in Satoshi 14px Medium; Right-aligned 'List Your Truck' CTA in White button with Black text and a mobile menu trigger.

Width 288px. Vertical stack of glass panels. Top panel: 'Filters' heading with Lucide icon. Includes: 'Pickup City' and 'Route' dropdowns (styled with white/5 bg and 1px borders), 'Truck Type' checkbox group with blue accent-color, and a 'Available Only' toggle switch. Bottom panel: 'Verified Partners' list with smaller card-in-card elements.

Horizontal glass bar. Left: Results count (e.g., '124 Found') and active metadata in 10px uppercase tracking-widest text. Right: 'SORT BY' label and a styled custom select dropdown. Below: a row of active filter pills (Blue/10 bg, Blue border) with 'x' close icons.

Grid layout: 1 column (mobile), 2 columns (tablet/desktop). Uses a perspective-container wrapper. Each card (TruckCard3D) should have a 4/3 aspect ratio image header with status badges, followed by specs in a 2x2 grid (white/5 bg) and dual primary CTAs (WhatsApp Green #22C55E and Glass Button).

Centered bottom navigation. Elements: 48px square buttons with rounded-2xl corners. Active page: Blue #2563eb with drop shadow. Inactive pages: Glass style with light gray text. Chevron icons for Next/Prev.

special_ui_components.description: Interactive listing card with dynamic 3D tilt and shimmer effect.
special_ui_components.prompt: Container: rounded-[2.5rem], p-4, glass background. Inner components: 1. Image container with aspect-4/3 and overflow-hidden, featuring status badges (e.g., 'AVAILABLE' in Emerald). 2. Specs grid: 2 columns, each cell p-4 rounded-2xl bg-white/5. 3. Interaction: On mousemove, apply transform: rotateX and rotateY based on cursor position relative to card center. Add a pseudo-element ::after with a 45-degree white gradient moving across the card (shimmer animation).
Toggle switch: 44px x 24px pill shape. Track: bg-white/10 (off) / bg-blue-600 (on). Thumb: 20px white circle with a 2px offset. Smooth transition: all 0.3s ease-in-out.

structured.special_notes: Must maintain a strict 1px border-radius consistency (2rem to 2.5rem for large containers). Must use the shimmer animation on cards to imply premium quality. Do not use solid backgrounds for any panels; everything must have some degree of transparency and blur. The 3D rotation on hover should not exceed 5-10 degrees to ensure text remains readable.
